english.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that someone or something makes a result happen.

exampleSentences.english: Continuous rain can cause the venue to get completely wet.
exampleSentences.traditional: 連續落雨令到場地濕晒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: lin4 zuk6 lok6 jyu5 ling6 dou3 coeng4 dei6 sap1 saai3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for causing or bringing about a result.

exampleSentences.english: This heavy rain can induce flooding all along the street.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢場大雨令到成條街水浸。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 ling6 dou3 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 seoi2 zam3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something brings about a consequence.

exampleSentences.english: Heavy rain can result in many flight delays.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢場大雨令到好多航班延誤。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 hong4 baan1 jin4 ng6
